domain: waste transfer notes at a recycling centre
role: Weighbridge compliance officer checking incoming waste transfer notes at a municipal recycling centre
setting: Each record is one inbound delivery: the producer's waste transfer note, the carrier's registration details, the weighbridge ticket, the load inspection, the site permit extract and the producer's delivery history. The officer reviews one delivery at a time. They decide whether the declared waste code is borne out by inspection, what to do with the load, what follow-up is needed, how far the weighed quantity departs from the declared one, and how many required note entries are missing.

code_matches_load.instructions: Declared EWC code matches the material recorded at load inspection.

load_disposition.instructions: What should the site do with this load and note?

criteria.accept: Tip normally; documents complete and load matches the note.
criteria.accept_conditional: Tip with downgrade or surcharge; documents complete, load quality short.
criteria.hold: Quarantine load pending one outstanding document or confirmation.
criteria.reject: Turn the load away; it cannot lawfully be received.

follow_up.instructions: What follow-up with the producer or carrier does this note need?

criteria.none: No follow-up; note and load raise no issues.
criteria.file_note: Log a minor discrepancy internally without contacting anyone.
criteria.request_amendment: Ask producer to reissue a corrected transfer note.
criteria.formal_warning: Send written duty-of-care warning to producer or carrier.
criteria.regulator_referral: Refer the note and load to the environmental regulator.

weight_variance.instructions: How far does weighbridge net weight differ from declared quantity?
criteria: Negligible: net within 5% of declared quantity
Minor: net differs by over 5% up to 15%
Major: net differs by over 15% up to 40%
Gross: net differs from declared by over 40%

doc_gaps.instructions: How many required transfer note entries are missing or null?
criteria: All required note entries present and completed
Exactly one required entry missing or null
Two or three required entries missing or null
Four or more required entries missing or null

factors.name: weight_discrepancy_pct
factors.description: Absolute percentage gap between the quantity declared on the note and weighbridge gross minus tare.

factors.name: unit_convention_differs
factors.description: Note declares the quantity in tonnes while the weighbridge reports kg, so the reader must convert before comparing.

factors.name: code_mismatch
factors.description: How the declared EWC code relates to the material observed at inspection.

factors.name: inspection_status
factors.description: Whether the load inspection was carried out and recorded fully.

factors.name: contamination_pct
factors.description: Share of non-target material estimated at inspection; drives downgrade or surcharge.

factors.name: missing_doc_items
factors.description: Number of required note entries left null or absent, drawn from producer_sig, carrier_sig, ewc_code, sic_code, qty, carrier_reg_no, transfer_date and producer_postcode.

factors.name: carrier_reg_state
factors.description: Carrier registration status on the delivery date.

factors.name: renewal_receipt_present
factors.description: A renewal application receipt dated before expiry is on file, mitigating an expired registration.

factors.name: signature_after_delivery
factors.description: The producer signature timestamp falls after the weighbridge time_in, showing the note was completed out of order.

factors.name: moisture_allowance_agreed
factors.description: The contract carries an agreed moisture tolerance covering wet-weather weight gains, mitigating an overweight load.

factors.name: producer_prior_rejections
factors.description: Count of rejected or held loads from this producer in the last 12 months.

factors.name: vehicle_reg_mismatch
factors.description: How the vehicle registration on the note compares with the weighbridge ANPR read.

factors.name: code_on_permit
factors.description: Whether the declared EWC code appears on the site permit's accepted list.

factors.name: boundary_placement
factors.description: Places weight_discrepancy_pct or contamination_pct within 0.5 points of a level threshold, or balances one mitigation against one alarm.

sections.name: transfer_note
sections.description: Producer's note: note_id, transfer_date, producer details, sic_code, ewc_code, qty, qty_unit, container, signatures with timestamps.

sections.name: carrier
sections.description: Carrier name, carrier_reg_no, reg_tier, reg_expiry, renewal_receipt_date, vehicle_reg.

sections.name: weighbridge
sections.description: Ticket_no, time_in, time_out, anpr_reg, gross_kg, tare_kg, tare_source.

sections.name: inspection
sections.description: Inspected_at, observed_ewc, primary_material, contamination_pct, prohibited_items, photos_count; null if not done.

sections.name: site_permit
sections.description: Permit_ref, accepted_ewc list, daily_cap_t, tonnage_today_t, contract moisture_allowance_pct.

sections.name: producer_history
sections.description: Deliveries_12m, rejections_12m, holds_12m, last_rejection_date, list of recent ticket_nos.

rendering_notes: weight_discrepancy_pct is never stated. It shows only as transfer_note.qty and qty_unit against weighbridge.gross_kg minus tare_kg; when unit_convention_differs, qty is in t and must be converted. moisture_allowance_agreed sets site_permit.moisture_allowance_pct to a value (for example 8) or null. code_mismatch shows as inspection.observed_ewc and primary_material differing from transfer_note.ewc_code; hazardous_mirror_entry uses an asterisked code observed against a non-asterisked declared code. inspection_status not_done sets inspection to null. Partial keeps photos_count but sets observed_ewc and contamination_pct to null, which makes code_matches_load false. missing_doc_items nulls that many required note fields, chosen at random from the listed set. carrier_reg_state shows via carrier.reg_expiry against transfer_date, or carrier_reg_no null or flagged reg_found:false. renewal_receipt_present fills carrier.renewal_receipt_date before reg_expiry. signature_after_delivery makes transfer_note.producer_sig_at later than weighbridge.time_in. vehicle_reg_mismatch alters anpr_reg against carrier.vehicle_reg; transposed_chars is a benign typo. code_on_permit controls whether ewc_code appears in site_permit.accepted_ewc. producer_prior_rejections fills producer_history counts. Decoys: container type, tare_source (stored or fresh), ticket number sequence, tonnage_today_t near but below daily_cap_t, a wet-weather flag in weighbridge without any contract allowance, last_rejection_date older than 12 months, and trivial weight gaps under 1%. Mismatches are never flagged. No field may name an outcome: no variance_pct, missing_count, compliant, risk, status_ok or recommended_action fields. No free-text notes or comments anywhere.
